method: Manual landmarks on unmodified native PNGs. Standing-equivalent height = reference standing height × pose crown-to-chin span / reference crown-to-chin span. This preserves head/anatomical scale when a generated low silhouette fills more of its canvas; the visible crouched bounding-box height is not used as standing height. Pivots follow pelvis axis and lowest planted/supporting sole; aerial pivots mark the virtual sole baseline before simulation altitude is applied.
limitations: Landmarks are visually measured, not a certified skeletal reconstruction.
One keyframe per action state; intermediate animation frames remain missing.
No canonical 1:1 certification; these are identity-preserving derivatives of the existing project drawing.
